name: footprint
meaning: world box centred on pos with the model-box half extents (flags 0 at +0x64, min +0x68, max +0x6e); used for the rider scan and the ground query

name: raisedBox
meaning: Box* set by Init to &+0x88; read 31 times as a Box by seesaw_CollideBody (0x4edb56..0x4edd10, in the chunk Ghidra split off at 0x4ed99f)

name: footprintUp500
meaning: copy of the footprint with the top (min.y +0x7e) raised 500

name: footprintUp1500
meaning: copy of +0x78 with the top raised another 1000

name: centreOnAxis
meaning: coordinate subtracted from obj.x (or .z when axisIsZ) to classify the landing side (+-30 dead zone)

name: plankTopOffset
meaning: -modelBox.min.y: height of the plank top above the pivot; pivotY = pos.y - plankTopOffset*cos>>12

name: halfWidth
meaning: half extent across the plank axis

name: halfLength
meaning: half extent along the plank axis

name: tilt
meaning: plank angle (4096/turn), clamped to [-maxTiltNeg, maxTiltPos]; written into rot.z

name: maxTiltNeg
meaning: MAXANGLE degrees * 4096/360

name: maxTiltPos
meaning: MAXANGLE2 * 4096/360, or maxTiltNeg when 0

name: tiltVel
meaning: low-pass filtered tilt error (3*delta when |delta| > 0xcd, else (3*v + delta)/4)

name: bodyCount
meaning: entries in bodies (max 32)

name: launchCount
meaning: seesaw-driven launches (max 32)

name: bodies
meaning: 32 x {s32 landingSpeed; s32 canLaunch; ScnObject *obj} filled by seesaw_AddBody

name: launches
meaning: arcs the seesaw drives itself (objects that returned 0 to msg 0xC)

name: launchPos
meaning: last arc position per launch

name: traj
meaning: TRAJ1/TRAJ2 export records (kind 3 only); objects on the negative/positive side are launched along them

name: launchCam
meaning: CAMERA1/CAMERA2 camera setups handed to seesaw_LaunchObject

name: launchCamFlags
meaning: CamScriptFlags: (CAMERAnINTERPB != 0) | (CAMERAnINTERPE != 0)<<1

name: pivotY
meaning: plank surface height at the pivot

name: pivotAxisCoord
meaning: pos.x (X plank) or pos.z (Z plank)

name: tiltSin
meaning: sin(tilt) 4.12

name: tiltCos
meaning: cos(tilt) 4.12 (0x1000 at Create)

name: camShot
meaning: launch camera shot

name: ejectionBox1
meaning: EJECTIONBOX1 (Scn_FindIdList, only when the list has exactly one entry; 0x4eb973..): tested against Ralph's position by 0x4ebbb7 to arm the ejection timer on that side

name: ejectionBox2
meaning: EJECTIONBOX2 (Scn_FindIdList, only when the list has exactly one entry; 0x4eb973..): tested against Ralph's position by 0x4ebbb7 to arm the ejection timer on that side

name: ejectionTimer1
meaning: ejection timer (ms) for side 1: 4000 while Ralph is inside its ejection box, 100 while Wolf msg 0x40E is nonzero, else -= g_dtMs (0x4ebc6b..). >0 makes a Wolf landing on that side a speed-48000 launch; zeroed by AddBody/LaunchObject

name: ejectionTimer2
meaning: ejection timer (ms) for side 2: 4000 while Ralph is inside its ejection box, 100 while Wolf msg 0x40E is nonzero, else -= g_dtMs (0x4ebc6b..). >0 makes a Wolf landing on that side a speed-48000 launch; zeroed by AddBody/LaunchObject

name: creakSound
meaning: handle of sound 0x108; cleared when it stops or on Reset

name: seesawFlags
meaning: bit 1: launch camera shot does not freeze the Wolf

name: axisIsZ
meaning: 0: plank along X, else along z

name: pendingLaunch
meaning: bit 0 negative side, bit 1 positive side, bit 2 set by a falling/rolling Rock landing (msg 0x5C == 1)

name: hopIdx
meaning: next hopTraj slot (mod 4)

name: hopTraj
meaning: 4 trajectory records of 0x14 bytes: {3; obj pos; (x, y-300, z); (x, seesaw.y, z)}, a vertical hop for sheep
